title: Meet Us at the 12th İstanbul Publishing Fellowship
summary: Applications for the 12th Fellowship are open until 31 December 2026
body:
Applications are still open for the **12th İstanbul Publishing Fellowship**, which will bring the international publishing community together in İstanbul on **23–25 March 2027**.

Held over three days, the programme creates a dedicated meeting point for publishers, literary agents, and rights professionals from Türkiye and around the world. Through structured one-to-one meetings, title presentations, seminars, and copyright negotiations, participants can discover new publishing lists, discuss translation opportunities, and build lasting international partnerships. Once the appointment system opens, the platform accessible through the Fellowship’s official website makes it easy for accepted participants to browse profiles and arrange B2B meetings in advance. Both in-person and online participation will be available.

Epsilon Publishing Group has attended the İstanbul Publishing Fellowship every year since 2019. As one of the first major publishing events in our annual calendar, it holds a particularly special place for our Foreign Rights Team. We always look forward to these three days: reconnecting with our colleagues, welcoming publishing friends to our home city, discovering new stories, and beginning conversations that may grow into future collaborations. And the Fellowship experience continues after the day’s meetings are over. The evenings are filled with social and cultural activities that give our guests the opportunity to discover İstanbul and its rich history.

While we count down to the 2027 programme, we would like to remind our international colleagues that applications are still open. We would be delighted to welcome you to İstanbul and talk about books and rights over Turkish coffee, accompanied by the city’s captivating views, delicious food, and, almost certainly, a few friendly cats.

Applications close on **31 December 2026**.

**Apply here:**
[12th İstanbul Publishing Fellowship – Application Form](https://www.b2match.com/e/12th-istanbul-publishing-fellowship/sign-up/create-account)

We are already looking forward to three inspiring days of books, conversations, and new connections. **See you all in İstanbul!**
